notes:
Image to 3D now preserves colored parts that background removal can mistake for the backdrop in neutral studio photos. The correction restores material connected to the detected subject, including thin uprights and mounting plates. Transparent inputs retain their supplied silhouette. Detailed mode now measures the decoded surface and can resample it more finely when the first mesh falls short of the target.

A field-sampling regression increased resolution from 640 to 864 and produced 1,182,824 triangles. The wall-mount reference recovered 59,300 foreground pixels. The colored-background owl control retained the original mask. The packaged Windows app generated a fresh 1342569-triangle textured holder directly from the opaque PNG and reopened its four-filament preview. A separate corrected holder from this reference contained 1,271,656 triangles in a single connected mesh with two uprights at three sampled heights. Mount strength and dimensional fit have not been physically tested.

Source commit e74817b04cff0abfaaaff55997b41df14bb8d024.
